# PLAN — iteration 2

## Current state assessment

The incumbent is timing-feasible at 39 LUTs, WNS 0.558 ns, and WHS 0.251 ns. Iteration 1 was rejected because its unchanged wrapper produced no strict LUT reduction. The editable top is only a transparent wrapper, and the frozen `uart_tx_core` contains the design logic.

## Hypothesis

With the child instance and its connections fixed, an RTL-only edit to this wrapper has no credible path to reduce LUT usage below 39; only an explicitly allowed flow variation could test for a different mapping.

## Instruction for generator

Keep the `uart_tx_core #( .DIV(868) ) u_uart_tx_core` instance and all six port connections unchanged, including the direct output connections to `in_ready` and `tx`. Do not add aliases or logic that only restates those connections, and do not claim an LUT gain from a source-only change. If the loop requires a genuine RTL optimization, request replanning to permit changes to the frozen core; otherwise evaluate only a permitted flow variation and require routed evidence of fewer than 39 LUTs with every verification and timing gate passing.
